messages:
kevin: Heads up — small invoice-preview delta after the routing tweak at 14:12 UTC. Preview attributed tokens to `route:cheap-v2` but ledger shows `route:legacy`. Anyone on the rollout?
maya: That was my change to prefer cheaper variants for low-priority traffic. Passed QA but I missed that it changes the `route_resolution_id` we forward to metering.
jamal: That explains it. pricebook join uses route_resolution_id to pick SKU. If router returned alias instead of canonical id, invoice preview gets wrong price.
sara: Paste an example event? ops needs exact keys to search.
kevin: Pasted two sanitized events: one has `route_hint: cheap-v2` + `route_resolution_id: legacy` (old shim), the other has both as `cheap-v2` (new shim).
liam: Also saw telemetry drop — sampler in the new policy dropped route_hint sampling from 10%->1% so dashboards missed the ramp.
jamal: Proposal: 1) add `route_alias` and `route_canonical` fields to canonical event so metering can prefer canonical; 2) emit `routing_override=true` telemetry when we substitute routes; 3) alert rule: preview/invoice delta >0.5% + routing_override => tag as routing-related.
kevin: Also add defensive pricebook join: prefer `route_canonical || route_resolution_id || route_hint`. Backfill affected window and mark `reconciled=true`.
sara: UI: show a "Routing override" badge on invoice preview with hover text. I'll mock microcopy.
maya: I'll revert rollout for 30m while we patch shim to emit both ids and schedule a targeted backfill.
deploy-bot: deploybot: Rollback requested by @maya at 2023-11-15T14:28:03Z; scheduled 2023-11-15T14:30:00Z.
billing-bot: billingbot: Invoice-preview-alert: preview != ledger >0.6% for tenants t_alpha,t_beta,t_gamma; auto-flagged.
jamal: Backfill plan: snapshot ledger to S3 (ttl 7d), run reconciler dry_run=true to validate, then apply targeted backfill and mark backfilled events `reconciler:reconciled`. Include `replay_origin=router-fix` telemetry tag.
liam: I'll audit sampling config parity between router shim and prod agent and add a dashboard for `routing_override` rate.
maya: Thanks — summary: revert (in flight), ship shim patch to include canonical id, run snapshot + dry-run backfill, pause further routing rollouts until sign-off. Posting reconciler dry-run results in 45m. :thumbsup:
